research_rationale: The complete held EO12720 original establishes the Council and ancillary advisory, information, support, expense and FACA functions. Its original §3(e) two-year term was replaced by EO12783 with an express January 16, 1993 termination. The immediate replacement directive contains no delayed effective clause; December 17, 1991 is inferred from its operative direction and execution, not blindly copied from metadata. Original §3(e) ends on replacement, while remaining Council-dependent commands cease January 16, 1993. EO12869 §§4(c),6 formally revoke September 30, 1993 and do not supply the first end. No independent policy direction survives the Council; accrued statutory travel claims do not continue its executive functions. The OFR disposition/corpus search covers this post-1937 order and locates the extension and revocation; no conflicts or missing actor provisions are listed. This is a bounded search judgment on this provisional dossier, not a present-law or readiness finding.
